direction.situation: Colombo roadside, in light rain, just after Anudi turned toward Kasun and he stepped up to return her phone; this clip continues as he answers her thanks and keeps the moment gentle and open.
direction.people: Kasun (on screen): steady, friendly, modest; standing on the right, chest-and-head MCU facing left, wants to ease her worry and be polite. Anudi (off-frame left): receptive earlier, now listening from just out of frame, her presence softens him but she is not visible in this shot.

flow.text: 0–1.1s: Kasun holds an available, unpressing stance with a small, genuine smile; he keeps his eyeline left, ready to respond.

flow.how: gentle and matter-of-fact, with a slight head incline as he speaks
flow.listener: Anudi listens off-frame, her eyes on him; a small, surprised-relieved smile forms at hearing his calm explanation

flow.text: 2.9–4s: Kasun stops speaking and holds his position, leaving space for her; his lips settle and his gaze remains steady, available but not pressing.

direction.camera: MCU of Kasun (chest and head), eye-level, frame right facing left; 65mm lens, locked-off on sticks.
direction.sound: light steady rain, distant traffic and the occasional three-wheeler; no music.
